blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.
blocks.zh: 皮肤癌的诊断,特别是将黑色素瘤与良性nevi区分开来,具有挑战性,因为损伤之间的视觉相似性. 虽然进化神经网络(CNNs)和视觉变换器(ViTs)表现出有希望的性能,但其有效性在来自不同临床来源的数据上往往会恶化. 常规域适应方法处理域位转移,但要求在适应过程中获取源数据,由于隐私规定,这些数据往往不可行. 多源无监督域适应(MSFDA)通过利用多个被贴上标签的源域一般化到一个未贴上标签的目标域而解决了这一限制,而不需要访问源数据. 然而,现有的MSFDA方法依赖于完全的主干线微调,导致灾难性地遗忘并过度适应小型临床数据集,并在集合阶段解决域位转移而未建立共享域位-变量特征空间. 此外,它们对硬伪标签或信心加权汇总的依赖,在域转移下引入了吵闹的监督信号. 为解决这些局限性,我们提议CAT-CKD,由两个部分组成:(1) 对比性适配器训练(CAT),在被冻结的ViT主干内使用有监督的对比性学习(SCL)对轻量级ConvPass适配器进行培训,以便在针对特定来源的模型培训之前建立共享域-不变量特征空间;(2) 共识知识分馏(CKD),将来自多源模型的对数汇总成共识监督信号,并使用KL分数对未贴标签的目标数据进行校正。 对5个可公开获得的皮肤损伤数据集的实验表明,CAT-CKD平均实现86.1%的AUROC,优于现有的MSFDA方法,而只需要4.3M可训练参数. 该代码可见于https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Melanoma is one of the most aggressive and potentially fatal forms of skin cancer, responsible for a large number of skin cancer-related deaths worldwide [ 43 , 28 ] . Early and accurate diagnosis of melanoma is crucial, as it is highly treatable in its initial stages but can rapidly metastasize if left undetected [ 33 ] . Differentiating melanoma from benign skin lesions such as nevi is a fundamental challenge in dermatology due to their similar visual appearance [ 11 , 22 ] . This motivates the development of computer-aided diagnostic systems to assist clinicians in improving diagnostic accuracy.
blocks.zh: 梅拉诺马是皮肤癌最有攻击性和潜在致命性的形式之一,导致全世界大量与皮肤癌有关的死亡[43,28]. 早期和准确诊断黑色素瘤至关重要,因为它在初始阶段极易被治疗,但如果留作未被发现,则可以被迅速变形[33]. 将黑色素瘤与良性皮肤损伤(如nevi)区分开来,是皮肤科的一个根本性挑战,因为其视觉外观相似[11,22]. 这促使开发计算机辅助诊断系统来帮助临床医生提高诊断准确性.

blocks.en: In recent years, deep learning techniques, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) [ 16 , 19 , 21 ] and vision transformers (ViTs) [ 9 ] , have shown promising results in medical image analysis, including skin cancer diagnosis [ 11 , 28 ] . However, the limited availability of annotated data drives researchers to rely on existing labeled datasets collected from multiple clinical centers, as annotation requires scarce domain expertise and is prohibitively time-consuming [ 57 ] . Nevertheless, a major obstacle remains: the domain shift problem. Variations in imaging devices, acquisition protocols, and patient demographics across centers introduce discrepancies between source and target domains, which substantially degrade the generalizability of deep learning models when deployed in previously unseen clinical data [ 48 , 40 , 15 , 3 ] . Compounding this challenge, privacy regulations and institutional policies [ 24 ] typically prevent source data from being revisited once a model is deployed to a new clinical environment [ 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 近年来,深层学习技术,如革命神经网络(CNN)[16,19,21]和视变器(ViTs)[9]等,在包括皮肤癌诊断在内的医学影像分析中显示出有希望的结果[11,28]. 然而,附加说明的数据有限,促使研究人员依靠从多个临床中心收集的现有标注数据集,因为注释需要稀缺的领域专门知识,而且耗时太长[57]。 然而,一个主要障碍依然存在:域位转移问题。 成像设备、获取协议和各中心病人人口结构的变化造成来源域和目标域之间的差异,在以前未见的临床数据中部署深层学习模型时,这种差异大大地降低了其通俗性[48、40、15、3]。 除了这一挑战之外,隐私条例和机构政策[24] 通常防止一旦将一个模型用于新的临床环境,就重新审查源数据[59]。

blocks.en: Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses domain shift by leveraging labeled data from multiple source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data during adaptation. This setup aligns better with real-world clinical settings, where privacy regulations often prevent access to source datasets during deployment [ 8 , 4 ] . While promising, existing MSFDA methods suffer from two key limitations. First, they rely on full backbone fine-tuning during adaptation, which causes catastrophic forgetting of pretrained representations and overfitting on the small, imbalanced datasets typical of clinical settings. Second, they attempt to reconcile domain shift at the aggregation or adaptation stage [ 56 ] , without first establishing a shared domain-invariant backbone, which if available, could be frozen during source-specific model training, reducing both overfitting and computational overhead. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels that directly propagate teacher errors [ 1 ] , or confidence-weighted aggregation that amplifies errors from overconfident teachers [ 30 , 38 ] , introduces noisy supervision signals that are unreliable under the domain shift conditions inherent to multi-center clinical data.
blocks.zh: 多源无监督域适应(MSFDA)通过利用多个源域的被标注的数据来将通用到一个没有被标注的目标域而解决了域位转移,而不需要在适应过程中访问源数据. 这种设置更能与现实世界的临床环境相配合,其中隐私规定在部署时经常会阻碍获取源数据集[8,4]. 虽然有希望,但现有的医师无国界协会方法受到两个关键限制。 首先,它们在适应过程中依靠完全的骨干微调,这造成灾难性地忘记了预先训练过的表示,过度适应临床环境所特有的小而不平衡的数据集. 第二,它们试图在汇总或适应阶段调和域位转移[56],而不首先建立共享域-变量主干网,如果有这种主干网的话,可以在特定源模型培训期间被冻结,减少过度调整和计算间接费用。 此外,他们依赖直接传播教师错误的硬伪标签[1],或信心加权汇总,放大过度自信教师的错误[30,38],引入了在多中心临床数据所固有的域转移条件下不可靠的噪音监督信号.

blocks.en: To address the challenge of noisy supervision under domain shift, knowledge distillation (KD) [ 17 ] can facilitate the transfer of information from well-trained source models to a target model, which enables effective learning without direct access to the source data [ 35 , 34 ] . Using multiple teacher models allows KD to mitigate individual source biases and provide more robust supervision signals for the student model. The success of this process depends heavily on the quality of the teacher models, which must be carefully fine-tuned to ensure they provide accurate and consistent guidance.
blocks.zh: 为应对域转移下噪音监管的挑战,知识分馏(KD)[17]可以促进将信息从训练有素的源模型转移到目标模型,从而能够在不直接获取源数据的情况下进行有效学习[35,34]. 使用多教师模式可以使KD减轻单个源偏差,为学生模式提供更强大的监督信号. 这个过程的成功很大程度上取决于教师模型的质量,这些模型必须经过仔细的微调,以确保提供准确而一致的指导.

blocks.en: Addressing the absence of a shared domain-invariant backbone requires a training stage that leverages all available labeled source data jointly with an objective that explicitly encourages same-class samples from different domains to be close together in the feature space. However, directly fine-tuning large pretrained ViTs for this purpose is computationally expensive and prone to overfitting and catastrophic forgetting, particularly when labeled data are scarce and imbalanced across clinical centers. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods [ 14 ] , including adapters [ 52 , 25 ] and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 20 , 53 ] , offer a practical solution by updating only a small subset of parameters while keeping the backbone frozen, thereby preserving pretrained knowledge and reducing the risk of overfitting. This makes PEFT particularly well-suited for building a shared domain-invariant backbone in the MSFDA setting, where labeled data are limited and privacy constraints prevent repeated access to source data during deployment.
blocks.zh: 解决缺乏共享域-变量主干线的问题,需要有一个培训阶段,利用所有可用的有标签的源数据,其目标明确鼓励不同域的同级样本在地物空间相近. 然而,直接微调大型预训 用于这一目的的虚拟技术计算费用昂贵,容易过度适应和灾难性地被遗忘,特别是在贴有标签的数据稀缺和临床中心不平衡的情况下。 参数高效微调(PEFT)方法[14],包括适配器[52,25]和低档适应(LORA)[20,53],提供了一个实用的解决方案,仅更新了一小部分参数,同时使骨干被冻结,从而保留了被预先训练过的知识并降低了过度适应的风险. 这使得PEFT特别适合在MSFDA设置中构建一个共享域-变量主干线,其中被标注的数据有限,隐私限制使得在部署期间无法重复访问源数据.

blocks.en: This paper introduces CAT-CKD, an MSFDA framework for skin cancer diagnosis that directly addresses the limitations of prior methods through two complementary components. First, we introduce C ontrastive A dapter T raining (CAT) , a PEFT strategy that inserts convolutional bypass adapters (ConvPass) [ 25 ] into a frozen ViT backbone and trains them using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) [ 27 ] , which encourages intra-class compactness and inter-class separation across domains regardless of their origin, to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific models are built. Second, we design a C onsensus K nowledge D istillation (CKD) strategy, in which the logits from multiple trained source models are aggregated into a consensus supervision signal, which we show reduces logit-level variance compared to any single teacher, and used to adapt a student model on the unlabeled target domain via Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence, avoiding the unreliable confidence estimates that plague existing aggregation strategies under domain shift. Because adaptation relies solely on trained source models, the proposed framework avoids direct access to source-domain images during deployment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAT-CKD provides a practical and parameter-efficient solution for source-free adaptation in skin cancer diagnosis under data-sharing constraints.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了CAT-CKD,这是一个用于皮肤癌诊断的MSFDA框架,通过两个互补部分直接解决了先前方法的局限性. 首先,我们引入了Contrastive A dapter T rain(CAT),一种PEFT策略,将相旋绕行适配器(ConvPass) [25] 插入到被冻结的ViT主干中,并使用有监督的对比性学习(SCL)[27]来训练它们,这鼓励各域内部紧凑并进行分级,而不论其起源如何,在构建出自特定源的模型之前建立共享域-不变量特征空间. 其次,我们设计了一个C ensensus K nowledge D 闪烁(CKD)策略,在策略中,来自多个训练有素的源模型的日志被汇总成一个共识监督信号,我们显示与任何单一老师相比,日志级差异会减少,并用来通过Kullback-Leibler (KL) difference(KL)调整一个未标注目标域上的学生模型,避免了困扰域移下现有汇总策略的不可靠的信任估计. 由于适应完全依靠训练有素的源模型,因此拟议框架在部署时避免直接取用源域图像. 广泛的实验表明,CAT-CKD在数据共享的制约下为皮肤癌诊断中的无源适应提供了实用和参数效率高的解决方案.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work include: 1. We propose CAT-CKD, an MSFDA framework for skin cancer diagnosis that explicitly establishes a shared domain-invariant backbone before source-specific models are built, directly addressing the representation-level and supervision-level limitations of existing methods. 2. We introduce CAT, which trains ConvPass adapters using supervised contrastive learning across source domains in the MSFDA setting, producing a shared domain-invariant feature space while avoiding catastrophic forgetting and overfitting. 3. We design CKD, which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a theoretically grounded consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using a KL-divergence objective, providing more stable supervision than existing aggregation strategies. 4. We conduct extensive experiments, ablation studies, and efficiency analyses on five public skin lesion datasets, demonstrating competitive performance with substantially fewer trainable parameters than existing methods.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献包括: 1. 我们提议采用CAT-CKD,这是诊断皮肤癌的MSFDA框架,在建立特定来源模型之前明确建立共享域-变量主干,直接解决现有方法的代表性和监督层面的局限性。 2. 我们采用 " CAT " ,它利用MSFDA环境中不同源域的有监督的对比性学习来培训ConvPass适配器,产生一个共享的域-变量特征空间,同时避免灾难性的遗忘和过度适应。 3. 我们设计了CKD,将来自多个源模型的日志汇总成一个理论上基于共识的监督信号,并使用KL-潜水目标在未贴标签的目标数据上调整一个学生模型,提供比现有汇总战略更稳定的监督. 4. 我们在五个公共皮肤损伤数据集上进行了广泛的实验、消毒研究并进行了效率分析,显示出竞争力,可训练参数大大低于现有方法。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews related work in skin cancer diagnosis, domain adaptation, parameter-efficient fine tuning, and knowledge distillation. Section 3 presents the problem formulation and details the proposed CAT-CKD framework. Section 4 describes the experimental setup and discusses the results. Finally, Section 5 concludes the paper and outlines directions for future work.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Skin Cancer Diagnosis
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 皮肤癌诊断

blocks.en: Recent research has increasingly leveraged deep learning methods to distinguish melanoma from benign nevi. CNNs are the most widely used techniques, typically fine-tuned from ImageNet-pretrained architectures such as DenseNet [ 21 ] , which uses dense connections between layers to encourage feature reuse, ResNet [ 16 ] , which introduces residual connections to enable training of very deep networks, and MobileNet [ 19 ] , which employs depthwise separable convolutions for lightweight and efficient inference . In [ 11 ] , a pre-trained CNN model is fine-tuned on over 120,000 dermoscopic images to classify lesions as either melanoma or benign, using a softmax-generated malignancy probability threshold of 0.5. The study in [ 28 ] fine-tunes four pretrained CNN architectures, including DenseNet121, ResNet50V2, NASNetMobile, and MobileNetV2, by applying extensive data augmentation to a dataset of 8,825 images. However, CNNs primarily focus on local features due to their limited receptive fields, which restricts their ability to capture long-range dependencies and global context [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的研究越来越多地利用深层的学习方法来区分黑色素瘤和良性nevi. CNN是使用最广泛的技术,典型的微调来自ImageNet的先入为主的架构,例如DenseNet[21],该架构利用地层之间的密集接通来鼓励特性再利用,ResNet[16],该技术引入了剩余接通,以便能够对非常深的网络进行培训,而MobileNet[19],该技术采用可深度分解的分流来进行轻量和高效的推论. 在[11]中,经过预先训练的CNN模型在超过12万个皮肤图像上被微调,将损伤分为黑色素瘤或良性,使用软马克产生的恶性概率阈值为0.5. [28]中的研究通过对由8,825个图像组成的数据集应用广泛的数据增强,微调了4个预先训练的CNN架构,包括DenseNet121,ResNet50V2,NASNetMobile和MobileNetV2. 然而,有线电视新闻网主要关注当地特色,因为它们的可接受性领域有限,限制了它们捕捉远程依赖性和全球背景的能力[32].

blocks.en: To overcome the limitations of CNNs, recent studies have explored ViTs, which employ self-attention mechanisms [ 46 ] to model relationships between image regions. This design enables ViTs to integrate information across both local and long-range spatial dependencies. Their success across a wide range of vision tasks has generated growing interest in applying ViTs to skin cancer diagnosis. RETFound [ 22 ] fine-tunes a ViT model to classify ultrawidefield color and autofluorescence fundoscopy images without the need for augmentation or handcrafted features. In [ 2 ] , architectures such as ConvNeXt, ViT-Base-16, and Swin V2 leverage self-attention and patch-based designs to enhance diagnostic performance. Additionally, GAN-MBViT [ 49 ] employs a dual-branch training strategy to boost feature learning by combining StyleGAN2-ADA for generating melanoma images with a ViT enhanced by BatchFormer for classification. Finally, ScATNet [ 51 ] applies a multi-scale ViT to histopathology slides by using self-attention across image patches at different magnifications, enabling the effective fusion of features from various tissue scales. Despite these advances, existing skin cancer diagnosis methods typically do not address the domain shift that arises when models are deployed across heterogeneous clinical sources.
blocks.zh: 为了克服有线电视新闻网的局限性,最近的研究探索了ViTs,它利用自觉机制[46]模拟图像区域之间的关系. 这种设计使ViTs能够整合跨越局部和远距离空间依赖的信息. 它们在一系列广泛的愿景任务中的成功引起了人们越来越重视将维生素应用于皮肤癌诊断。 ReTFoud [22] 微调了一款ViT模型,将超宽场色和自发荧光透镜图像进行分类,而不需要增强或手动特性. 在[2]中,ConvNEXt,Vit-Base-16等建筑,和Swin V2等利用自意和补丁设计来提升诊断性能. 此外,GAN-MBViT[49]采用双分支培训战略,通过将StyleGAN2-ADA用于生成黑色素瘤图像与由BatchFormer增强的用于分类的ViT相结合来推动特征学习. 最后,ScATNet[51]对组织病理学幻灯片应用了多尺度的维T,在不同的放大度下,通过图像补丁的自觉作用,使各种组织尺度的特征能够有效融合. 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的皮肤癌诊断方法通常不会解决模型在不同临床来源之间部署时出现的域位转移问题。

blocks.en: 2.2 Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 无监督的领域适应

blocks.en: UDA aims to transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain with a different data distribution. DANN [ 12 ] learns domain-invariant and task-discriminative features by introducing a domain classifier connected through a gradient reversal layer. It reverses gradients during backpropagation to encourage indistinguishability between source and target domains. The method jointly trains the label predictor and domain classifier in an adversarial manner. ADDA [ 45 ] first learns a discriminative feature mapping from source data and then trains a separate target encoder to map target data into the same space through adversarial training against a domain discriminator. It uses unshared weights and a GAN-based loss to align source and target representations without requiring image generation or weight sharing. Beyond single-source UDA, many tasks require adaptation from multiple sources. MDAN [ 60 ] derives new generalization bounds for multiple source domain adaptation that motivate jointly learning domain-invariant, task-discriminative features. Two variants are proposed: a hard version optimizing a worst-case bound and a soft version using log-sum-exp weighting to adaptively combine gradients from all source domains.
blocks.zh: UDA旨在将知识从被标记的源域转移到一个具有不同数据分布的未被标记的目标域. DANN [12]通过引入一个通过梯度倒转层连接的域分级器来学习域-变量和任务-差异性特征. 它扭转了后向传播过程中的梯度,以鼓励源域与目标域之间无法区分. 该方法以对抗方式联合训练了标签预测器和域分级器. ADDA[45]首先从源数据中学习出一种有区别的特征映射,然后通过对抗域歧视者的培训,训练出一个单独的目标编码器来将目标数据映射到同一个空间. 它使用不共享的权重和基于GAN的损失来配合源和目标表达,而不需要图像生成或权重共享. 除了单源UDA之外,许多任务需要由多源适应. MDAN [60]为多个源域的适应提供了新的概括界限,激发了共同学习域-变量,任务-差异性特征的动力. 提出了两种变体:硬版优化最坏情形约束;软版采用对数和偏重来适应性地结合所有源域的梯度.

blocks.en:
While multi-source unsupervised domain adaptation requires access to source data, multi-source-free variants rely solely on trained source models and are therefore better suited to real-world scenarios.
DECISION [ 1 ] addresses MSFDA by leveraging only pre-trained source models and unlabeled target data to construct a target model through adaptive ensembling. It jointly optimizes model-specific feature extractors and combines weights through information maximization and pseudo-labeling. This design ensures that the target model performs at least as well as the best individual source model. EAAF [ 38 ] introduces two uncertainty measures: Evidential Prediction Uncertainty (EPU), which estimates how well each source model fits a given target sample to guide instance-level aggregation, and Evidential Adjacency-Consistent Uncertainty (EAU), which measures semantic consistency within local neighborhoods to enable reliable semantic propagation, all within a dual-branch Multinomial-Dirichlet network. Bi-ATEN [ 30 ] learns instance-specific and domain-consistent ensemble weights through a bi-level attention mechanism. It requires only minimal tuning of the source bottlenecks. While these methods demonstrate promising adaptation performance, they either require source data during adaptation or address domain shift only at the aggregation stage.
blocks.zh:
虽然多源无监督域适应需要获取源数据,但多源无源变体完全依赖于训练有素的源模型,因此更适合现实世界情景.
第[1]号决定只利用预先培训的源模型和无标签的目标数据,通过适应性聚合构建目标模型,从而解决MSFDA问题。 它通过信息最大化和伪标签,联合优化了模型特有特性提取器并结合了权重. 这种设计确保目标模型至少能够发挥最佳的单个源模型的作用. EAAF [38] 引入了两种不确定性措施:一种是指数预测不确定性(EPU),它估计每个源模型是否适合一个特定的目标样本来指导实例级聚合;另一种是指数Adjacency-相容不确定性(EAU),它测量当地街区内的语义一致性,以便能够可靠地进行语义传播,所有这些都在一个双分支多诺-Dirichlet网络内. Bi-ATEN [30] 通过双级关注机制,学习特有和域相容的群分. 它只需要对源的瓶颈进行最低限度的调整。 虽然这些方法显示了有希望的适应绩效,但它们要么在适应期间需要源数据,要么只在汇总阶段处理域转移。

blocks.en: 2.3 Parameter-Efficient Fine Tuning
blocks.zh: 2.3 参数-有效精细图解

blocks.en: PEFT methods aim to adapt large pretrained models to downstream tasks using a small number of trainable parameters. Early PEFT strategies for language models have inspired several adaptation techniques for vision models. Adapters [ 18 ] insert lightweight bottleneck modules between transformer layers, LoRA [ 20 ] decomposes weight updates into low-rank matrices to reduce trainable parameters, and Prefix-Tuning [ 29 ] prepends trainable tokens to the input sequence to guide model behavior, all while keeping the backbone frozen. Vision-specific PEFT variants have also shown competitive or superior performance to full fine-tuning, especially in low-data regimes. VPT [ 23 ] prepends learnable prompt tokens to the input of each transformer layer to adapt the model to downstream tasks. AdaptFormer [ 5 ] replaces the MLP layers in ViT with lightweight adapter modules for scalable visual recognition. NOAH [ 58 ] searches for optimal combinations of PEFT modules through neural architecture search to maximize adaptation performance. While methods like Med-SA [ 50 ] apply PEFT principles to interactive segmentation in medical imaging, they rely on user prompts and are not designed for multi-source-free domain adaptation. Most PEFT approaches also remain language-oriented, inheriting architectural biases suitable for NLP, such as sequence handling and weak spatial priors. Convpass [ 25 ] addresses this issue by proposing a vision-oriented PEFT method. It introduces convolutional bypasses in parallel with the multi-head self-attention (MHSA) and MLP blocks within ViT layers. These modules restore spatial locality by applying convolutional transformations to the flattened patch embeddings to bridge the gap between CNNs and transformers.

Convpass [25]通过提出面向视觉的PEFT方法来解决这一问题. 它在VIT地层内引入了与多头自留(MHSA)和MLP块平行的旋绕. 这些模块通过对平整的补丁嵌入来进行回旋转换来恢复空间位置,以弥补CNN和变压器之间的差距.

blocks.en: 2.4 Knowledge Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.4 知识扭曲

blocks.en: KD has become a widely adopted approach for compressing deep models by transferring knowledge from a large, well-performing teacher model to a smaller student model. Hinton et al. [ 17 ] introduced KD as a technique to transfer the generalization ability of a large or ensemble model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student) by training the student on soft targets. KDCL [ 13 ] is an online KD framework where multiple student networks collaboratively learn by sharing dynamically generated ensemble soft targets. This approach enhances generalization and does not rely on a pre-trained teacher. Attention transfer [ 54 ] is a KD method that improves student CNNs by forcing them to mimic the teacher’s spatial attention maps. While most early works used a single teacher, recent methods leverage multiple teachers to provide a broader supervision signal to the student. For example, AE-KD [ 10 ] formulates ensemble KD as a multi-objective optimization in gradient space. It adaptively weights teacher contributions based on their agreement to guide the student more effectively. MMKD [ 55 ] introduces a meta-weight network that adaptively combines multiple teachers’ logits and feature representations at the instance level using second-order optimization to ensure that the student receives diverse yet compatible knowledge tailored to its learning capacity. FEED [ 37 ] distills knowledge from multiple teachers at the feature-map level by introducing separate non-linear transformation layers for each teacher. This design allows the student network to align and absorb ensemble feature representations either in parallel or through sequential training.
blocks.zh: KD已经成为一种被广泛采用的方法来压缩深层模型,方法是将知识从一个大而表现良好的教师模型转移到一个较小的学生模型. 兴通等. [17]引入了KD作为一种技术,通过对学生进行软目标培训,将大型或综艺模型(老师)的通化能力转移到更小的模型(学生)上. KDCL [13]是一个在线KD框架,多个学生网络通过共享动态生成的综艺软目标来合作学习. 这种方法可以增强通俗化,不依靠经过预训的教师. 注意转移[54]是一种KD方法,通过强迫学生模仿老师的空间注意地图来改进学生CNN. 虽然大多数早期的作品都使用单人教师,但最近的方法利用多位教师向学生提供更广泛的监督信号. 例如AE-KD [10] 将组合 KD 设定为梯度空间的多目标优化. 它根据教师为更有效地指导学生所达成的协议,对教师的贡献进行适应性加权。 MMKD[55]引入了一个元加权网络,该网络适应性地结合了多个教师的对数,并采用二等优化法在实例层面的特色表述,以确保学生获得适合其学习能力的多样而相容的知识. FEED[37]通过为每个教师引入单独的非线性转换层,从特征图层面的多位教师中提取知识. 这种设计使学生网络能够同步或通过相继培训来对齐并吸收综艺特写.

blocks.en: CAT is a PEFT approach that incorporates adapters into the ViT architecture to mitigate the catastrophic forgetting challenge. These adapters are convolutional bypass modules [ 25 ] added in parallel to the existing MHSA and MLP blocks which allows efficient adaptation while preserving the original backbone structure. The modified transformation process in ViT with adapters is formulated as: X ′ ← X + MHSA/MLP ​ ( LN ​ ( X ) ) + Adapter ​ ( LN ​ ( X ) ) , X^{\prime}\leftarrow X+\text{MHSA/MLP}(\text{LN}(X))+\text{Adapter}(\text{LN}(X)), (2) where LN ​ ( ⋅ ) \text{LN}(\cdot) is the layer normalization function, MHSA/MLP( ⋅ \cdot ) represents the self-attention and feed-forward layers in ViT, and Adapter ​ ( ⋅ ) \text{Adapter}(\cdot) denotes the Convpass adapter module [ 25 ] . By training only the adapter parameters while keeping the ViT backbone frozen, we reduce the number of trainable parameters and minimize the risk of overfitting. This makes the model more suitable for domain adaptation in medical imaging.

blocks.en: CKD adapts a student model to the unlabeled target domain by treating the trained source models as a set of frozen teachers that provide soft supervisory signals. Rather than relying on a single teacher, CKD aggregates the predictions of all M M teachers to obtain a consensus target, which helps reduce the influence of any individual source-specific bias and provides a more stable supervision signal under domain shift. Moreover, using soft labels preserves inter-class similarity information and provides smoother gradients than hard pseudo-labels. This also mitigates hard-label bias when the consensus prediction is uncertain or incorrect (e.g., when teachers disagree), since the student is encouraged to match the full probability distribution rather than commit to a potentially erroneous one-hot target.

blocks.en: In this study, we utilized five publicly available datasets for skin lesion analysis: ISIC 2018 [ 7 , 44 ] , ISIC 2020 [ 41 ] , PAD-UFES-20 [ 36 ] , Derm7pt-Derm [ 26 ] , and Derm7pt-Clinic [ 26 ] . Images of melanoma and nevus were selected from each dataset because these two classes are the most challenging to differentiate and are the most clinically significant for skin-lesion diagnosis. In addition, all of the datasets used in this study contain samples from these two classes, ensuring consistency across domains.

blocks.en:
For all experiments, we use a batch size of 32 across all datasets to maintain consistency. ViT-B/16 pre-trained on ImageNet is used as the backbone across all experiments. The source models are trained for 20 epochs to ensure sufficient learning from the data, while the student model is trained for 15 epochs using the proposed CKD framework. The learning rate is set to 3 × 10 − 2 3\times 10^{-2} , with a warmup phase of 5% of the total training steps to stabilize the optimization process during the initial epochs. SGD is the optimizer, configured with a momentum of 0.9 to enhance convergence by maintaining directional consistency during updates. τ \tau in Eq. 3 is set to 0.2 based on the details provided in Section 4.6.5 .
The bottleneck of our method contains four fully connected layers comprising 2048, 1024, 512, and 256 nodes, respectively. The head consists of a single fully connected layer. We treat each dataset as an independent domain and employ a leave-one-domain-out protocol, where, in each experimental setting, one domain is selected as the unlabeled target and all other domains are used as labeled sources.

blocks.en: Data Augmentation. To enhance the robustness and generalization capability of our model, we apply a series of data augmentation techniques during the training process (see Figure 3 ). These augmentations simulate diverse imaging conditions, which are common in real-world scenarios, thereby enabling the model to better handle variability in the data. Specifically, we use resizing to ensure uniform input dimensions, random horizontal and vertical flips to introduce variability in orientation, and random rotations within a range of 0 to 90 degrees to account for angular variations in imaging setups. These transformations are implemented as part of a pre-processing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 数据扩能. 为了增强我们模型的稳健性和通俗性能力,我们在培训过程中采用了一系列数据增强技术(见图3)。 这些增强模拟各种成像条件,这些条件在现实世界情景中很常见,从而使模型能够更好地处理数据的可变性. 具体来说,我们使用再大小来保证输入维度的统一,随机水平和垂直翻转来引入取向的可变性,以及在0到90度范围内的随机旋转来说明成像设置的角变化. 这些转变是作为预处理管道的一部分进行的。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en:
To ensure a comprehensive evaluation, we select several well-established state-of-the-art models as baselines. Specifically, we consider both single-source and multi-source UDA methods, as well as multi-source-free UDA methods.
First, we include DANN [ 12 ] and ADDA [ 45 ] , two widely recognized UDA models. Since these models are designed for single-source domain adaptation, we combine all source datasets into a single dataset and use a separate dataset as the target domain to align with their training paradigm. This setup allows for a fair comparison of their effectiveness in a multi-source setting.
Next, we consider MDAN [ 60 ] , a well-known multi-source domain adaptation method that explicitly handles multiple source domains.
For comparison with our proposed MSFDA approach, we select DECISION [ 1 ] , Bi-ATEN [ 30 ] , and EAAF [ 38 ] , all of which are specifically designed for scenarios where source data is unavailable during adaptation. Since our method operates under similar privacy-preserving constraints, these baselines provide an appropriate benchmark for evaluating the effectiveness of our proposed framework.
All models are evaluated on the same datasets and data distributions to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh:
为确保全面评估,我们选择了几个公认的最新模型作为基线。 具体来说,我们既考虑单源和多源UDA方法,也考虑多源无源UDA方法.
首先,我们包括DANN[12]和ADA[45],两个被广泛认可的UDA模型. 由于这些模型是为单源域适应而设计的,因此我们将所有源数据集合并为一个单一数据集并使用单独的数据集作为目标域来配合其培训范式. 这种设置可以公平比较它们在多来源环境下的有效性。
接下来,我们认为MDAN [60],是一种著名的多源域适应方法,明确处理多源域.
与我们提议的MSFDA方法相比,我们选择了第[1]、Bi-ATEN[30]和EAAF[38]号决定,所有这些决定都是专门为适应期间没有源数据的情况设计的。 由于我们的方法在保护隐私的类似制约下运作,这些基线为评价我们拟议框架的有效性提供了一个适当的基准。
所有模型都在同一数据集和数据分布上进行评估,以确保公平比较。

blocks.zh: 4.4 结果

blocks.en: Performance. Table 2 presents the AUROC scores for CAT-CKD and the competing baselines. To further illustrate the severity of domain shift across datasets, we include a Source Only baseline, in which all source domains are pooled and a single model is trained using standard cross-entropy without any domain adaptation. The results demonstrate that CAT-CKD achieves strong performance across datasets in the MSFDA setting for skin cancer diagnosis. Importantly, the framework operates without access to source data during adaptation, thereby preserving data privacy. Despite this constraint, the method maintains robust generalization across domains, supporting its suitability for real-world clinical deployment. Notably, these results are obtained with a substantially reduced number of trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 表现 表2列示了阿拉伯臭氧观测站的CAT-CKD分数和相互竞争的基线。 为了进一步说明跨数据集域转移的严重性,我们包括了一个仅源基线,即所有源域都集合在一起,使用标准的跨域操作来培训单一模型,而没有任何域调整。 结果显示,CAT-CKD在用于皮肤癌诊断的MSFDA设置中,在各种数据集中取得了强劲的性能. 重要的是,该框架在适应过程中无法获取源数据,从而维护了数据隐私。 尽管存在这一制约因素,该方法在各个领域都保持了有力的通俗化,支持其适合现实世界的临床部署。 值得注意的是,这些成果是在大量减少可训练参数的情况下取得的。

blocks.en: To further illustrate the effectiveness of CAT-CKD, Figure 4 presents t-SNE visualizations of the target-domain feature embeddings before and after adaptation. Following adaptation, the features exhibit markedly improved inter-class separability and intra-class compactness. The resulting clusters are more coherent and better aligned with class boundaries, suggesting that CAT-CKD successfully learns a discriminative and domain-consistent feature representation that enhances generalization on the target domain.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步说明CAT-CKD的有效性,图4展示了T-SNE在适应前后嵌入目标域特征的可视化. 适应之后,这些特征明显地改善了阶级之间的分离性和阶级内部的紧凑性。 由此产生的集群更加一致,更能与类边界相配合,表明CAT-CKD成功学习出一种具有歧视性和域相容的特征代表,可以增强目标域的通俗化.

blocks.en:
Efficiency Analysis. Table 3 presents a comparison of trainable parameters between our proposed model and baselines. Existing methods, including EAAF [ 38 ] and DECISION [ 1 ] , involve training over 96M parameters, while others like DANN [ 12 ] and ADDA [ 45 ] still require tens of millions of parameters to be updated.
In contrast, our parameter-efficient design significantly reduces the number of trainable parameters by integrating lightweight adapters into a frozen ViT backbone. The full ViT model contains over 90 million parameters, but during the backbone training phase using CAT, only the adapter modules are updated—resulting in just 0.3 million trainable parameters. In the subsequent source model training and target adaptation stages, only the bottleneck and classification head are trained, with the total number of trainable parameters after CAT approximately 4.3 million. This represents a substantial reduction compared to fully fine-tuned baselines. The reduction in trainable parameters not only improves computational and memory efficiency, but also helps mitigate overfitting.
blocks.zh:
效率分析。 表3比较了拟议模型和基线之间的可训练参数。 现有方法,包括EAAF[38]和决定[1],涉及超过96M参数的培训,而DANN[12]和ADA[45]等其他方法仍需要更新上千万个参数。
相形之下,我们的参数效率设计通过将轻量级适配器整合入被冷冻的ViT主干线,大大减少了可受训练参数的数量. 完整的ViT模型包含超过9000万个参数,但在使用CAT的主干培训阶段,只有适配器模块被更新——结果只有30万个可训练参数. 在随后的源模式培训和目标适应阶段,只有瓶颈和分级头被培训,CAT后可培训参数总数约为430万. 与经过充分调整的基线相比,这是一个大幅度的减少。 可列车参数的减少不仅提高了计算和内存效率,还有助于缓解过度搭配.

blocks.zh: 表3:我们提议的模型和基线模型之间的可训练参数比较。

blocks.en: Discussion on Results. The experimental results demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed CAT-CKD framework in the context of MSFDA for skin cancer diagnosis. By adopting a parameter-efficient tuning strategy, the ViT backbone is adapted using lightweight adapters, enabling efficient optimization. This results in a robust and domain-invariant feature extractor capable of strong cross-domain generalization. Notably, the framework maintains competitive performance across diverse datasets without requiring access to source data during target adaptation, which is particularly important for privacy-sensitive medical applications. In addition, the significant reduction in trainable parameters improves computational efficiency and enhances suitability for deployment in resource-constrained clinical environments.
blocks.zh: 关于结果的讨论。 实验结果表明,拟议的CAT-CKD框架在MSFDA皮肤癌诊断方面具有实际效力。 通过采用参数高效的调试策略,使用轻量级适配器来调整ViT主干线,使能高效地优化. 由此形成了能强跨域通论的强力和域-无变量特征提取器. 值得注意的是,该框架保持不同数据集的竞争性业绩,而不需要在目标适应期间获取源数据,这对于对隐私敏感的医疗应用特别重要。 此外,可培训参数的大幅减少提高了计算效率并增强了在资源紧张的临床环境中部署的适宜性。

blocks.en: PAD-UFES-20 presents a uniquely challenging adaptation scenario, as confirmed by the pairwise Fréchet Distance matrix (Figure 2 ), where it exhibits the largest domain distances from all other datasets. The consistent performance drop across methods indicates that the difficulty arises from the severity of the domain gap rather than from CAT-CKD. Despite this, CAT-CKD achieves the highest average AUROC of 86.1% and outperforms all competing methods.
blocks.zh: PAD-UFES-20提出了具有独特挑战性的适应设想方案,对称的Fréchet远程矩阵(图2)证实了这一点,其中显示的域距所有其他数据集的最大距离。 跨方法的一贯性能下降表明,困难来自域间隙的严重性,而不是CAT-CKD. 尽管如此,CAT-CKD还是实现了86.1%的最高平均AUROC,并且超过了所有竞争方法。

blocks.en: Nevertheless, adaptation to target domains with large domain gaps remains challenging, especially when imaging modalities or acquisition conditions differ substantially. Moreover, while the framework extends to multi-class or multi-label settings with minimal modifications, constructing cross-domain datasets with consistent label definitions and realistic domain shifts remains a practical challenge.
blocks.zh: 然而,对存在大领域差距的目标域的适应仍然具有挑战性,特别是在成像模式或获取条件大相径庭的情况下。 此外,虽然框架扩展至多类或多标签设置,但最小的修改,构建具有一致标签定义和现实域移动的跨域数据集仍然是一个实际挑战.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 读取研究

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct an ablation study to evaluate the effectiveness of each component of the CAT-CKD framework. As such, we remove these components individually to assess their contributions. We first remove CAT and use the backbone in a frozen manner without the CAT-based finetuning step. We then evaluated fine-tuning the entire backbone instead of applying the CAT-based parameter-efficient adaptation. This full fine-tuning strategy resulted in inferior performance, due to overfitting on limited data and catastrophic forgetting of pretrained representations. To eliminate CKD, we supervise the student model using logits from a randomly selected single source model instead of leveraging the ensemble. For removing KL divergence, we substitute it with a standard cross-entropy loss. As shown in Table 4 , removing each component lead to notable performance degradation. These results confirm that all components in our proposed method are essential to the framework’s success, as removing either results in a substantial drop in AUROC, thereby validating the proposed design.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们开展一项消毒研究,以评估CAT-CKD框架每个组成部分的有效性。 因此,我们逐一删除这些组成部分,以评估它们的贡献。 我们首先删除CAT,并以冷冻的方式使用骨干,而不使用基于CAT的微调步骤. 然后,我们评价了整个主干线的微调,而不是采用基于CAT的参数效率调整。 这一全面微调战略导致业绩低下,因为数据过于有限,而且灾难性地忘记了事先训练过的表述。 为了消除CKD,我们用随机选择的单一源模型中的对数来监督学生模型,而不是利用综艺. 为了去除KL的相差,我们用一个标准的相差相差取而代之. 如表4所示,去除每个组成部分会导致显著的性能退化。 这些结果证实,我们拟议方法中的所有组成部分对框架的成功都至关重要,因为消除其中任何一项结果会导致阿拉伯团结和团结组织大幅下降,从而证实拟议的设计。

blocks.zh: 表 4: 评估我们框架内关键组成部分所产生影响的关联性研究。 我们报告AUROC在五个目标数据集和平均数上的分数。 最佳结果以黑体表示。

blocks.en: 4.6 Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 敏感性分析

blocks.en: In this section, we perform a sensitivity analysis to evaluate how hyperparameter settings and architectural components influence our model’s performance.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们进行敏感度分析,以评估超参数设置和建筑组件如何影响我们模型的性能。

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Effect of CAT on Attention Maps
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 禁止酷刑委员会对关注地图的影响

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows attention maps generated by the backbone, with and without CAT. Without CAT, attention is broadly dispersed across irrelevant background regions with little to no focus on the lesion area, indicating poor feature localization. Introducing CAT noticeably concentrates attention toward lesion regions, demonstrating that contrastive adapter training encourages the model to attend to more semantically relevant areas. While perfect lesion localization is not expected from ViT attention maps due to their global patch-relationship nature, the key observation is that CAT shifts the attention distribution toward more focused and semantically meaningful patterns, which indicates improved domain-invariant feature learning.
blocks.zh: 图5显示的是骨干生成的有和无CAT的注意力图. 如果没有《禁止酷刑公约》,注意力将广泛分散到不相关的背景地区,很少或根本没有关注损伤地区,这表明地方性特征差。 采用《禁止酷刑公约》将注意力明显地集中在病情地区,表明对比性适应器培训鼓励该模式关注更切合实际的领域。 虽然由于它们的全球补丁关系性质,ViT注意力图预计不会完美地损害局部化,但关键观察是CAT将注意力的分布转向更有重点和更精细有意义的模式,这表明域-无变量特征学习有所改进.

blocks.en: 4.6.2 Soft-label vs. Hard-label Knowledge Distillation
blocks.zh: 4.6.2 软标签与硬标签知识分解

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of supervision type during distillation, we compare the proposed soft-label CKD with a hard-label variant in which the consensus prediction is converted into one-hot pseudo-labels and the student is trained using cross-entropy loss. As shown in Table 5 , soft-label CKD achieves a higher average AUROC and delivers more robust performance on challenging targets such as PAD-UFES-20. This behavior arises because hard-label distillation propagates teacher errors directly when the consensus prediction is incorrect and enforces an overconfident, potentially noisy target. In contrast, soft-label distillation trains the student using the full predictive distribution, which preserves uncertainty and inter-class similarity information from multiple teachers.
blocks.zh: 为了评价分馏过程中监督类型的影响,我们把拟议的软标签CKD与硬标签变体相提并论,在硬标签变体中,共识预测被转换为一热伪标签,而学生则被使用交叉内损来训练. 如表5所示,软标签CKD实现较高的平均AUROC,并在PAD-UFES-20等具有挑战性的目标上提供更强的性能. 出现这种行为是因为硬标签蒸馏在协商一致的预测不正确时直接传播老师错误,并强制实施一个过度自信,可能吵闹的目标. 相形之下,软标签蒸馏则使用全预测分布来训练学生,这保存了来自多位教师的不确定性和班际相似性信息.

blocks.en: 4.6.3 Convpass vs. Other Adapter Models
blocks.zh: 4.6.3 Conpass vs. 其他适应器模型

blocks.en: To assess the effect of adapter architecture on the proposed method, we compare the ConvPass adapter with two widely used alternatives. The Houlsby adapter [ 18 ] inserts bottleneck modules after both the attention and feed-forward sublayers within each transformer block. In contrast, the Pfeiffer adapter [ 39 ] adopts a more lightweight design by placing a single adapter after the feed-forward layer only. Both variants employ a linear down-projection, non-linearity, and up-projection structure, but differ in their placement and overall expressiveness (see Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评估适配器架构对所提议方法的影响,我们比较了ConvPass适配器和被广泛使用的两个替代品. Houlsby适配器[18]在每个变压器块内的注意和向导子层后插入瓶颈模块. 相形之下,菲佛适配器[39]则采用更轻量级的设计,仅将单个适配器放入向后层后. 两种变体都采用线性下推法,非线性下推法和上推法结构,但其位置和总体表达性不同(见表6)。

blocks.en: 4.6.4 Effect of Different Consensus Label Generation Strategies
blocks.zh: 4.6.4 不同共识标签生成战略的效果

blocks.en:
We evaluate different strategies for generating consensus pseudo-labels from multiple teacher models during distillation. Under domain shift, variations in teacher confidence and reliability make the aggregation strategy a critical component of the distillation process.
As shown in Table 7 , in addition to uniform averaging (used in our method), we consider three confidence-aware alternatives: confidence-weighted averaging [ 6 ] (based on maximum softmax score), margin-based weighting [ 42 ] (using the top-1 vs. top-2 probability gap), and entropy-weighted averaging [ 31 ] (favoring low-entropy predictions). While these strategies aim to prioritize confident teachers, they rely on potentially miscalibrated confidence estimates. This can amplify errors from overconfident but incorrect teachers. Uniform averaging, by contrast, avoids such bias and provides a stable, balanced supervision signal across domains.
blocks.zh:
我们评价在蒸馏过程中从多种教师模型中生成共识伪标签的不同战略。 在域转移中,教师信心和可靠性的变化使得汇总战略成为分馏过程的关键组成部分.
如表7所示,除了统一平均值(在我们的方法中使用)外,我们考虑三种具有信心的替代方法:信心加权平均值[6](根据最大软马克斯分数),以比值为基础的加权值[42](使用上比一对上比二概率差),以及乙烯加权平均值[31](赞成低入比预测)。 虽然这些战略旨在优先考虑有信心的教师,但它们依赖于可能错估的信心估计。 这可能会扩大过度自信但错误的教师的错误。 相形之下,统一平均可以避免这种偏见,并提供一个稳定、均衡的跨领域的监督信号。

blocks.en: 4.6.5 Effect of τ \tau in Supervised Contrastive Learning
blocks.zh: 4.6.5\tau在监督学习中的影响

blocks.en: The temperature parameter τ \tau in SCL modulates the concentration of the similarity distribution and thus determines the strength of separation between positive and negative pairs. Lower values yield sharper distributions that emphasize hard negatives, whereas higher values produce smoother distributions with reduced contrastive force. We tested three common values: 0.07, 0.2, and 0.5. As shown in Figure 6 , τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 delivers the best performance by generating the most discriminative representations. In contrast, τ = \tau= 0.07 and 0.5 both diminish class separation, underscoring the importance of tuning τ \tau for effective domain-invariant feature learning.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we proposed CAT-CKD, a novel MSFDA framework for skin cancer diagnosis that preserves patient privacy by eliminating the need for source-domain images during adaptation. First, CAT instills domain-invariant, class-discriminative representations into a ViT backbone through SCL and lightweight adapters to reduce overfitting while retaining pretrained knowledge. Next, CKD transfers ensemble knowledge from frozen source models to a student network on unlabeled target data via a KL-divergence objective. Extensive experiments on five public dermoscopic datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both traditional UDA and state-of-the-art multi-source-free methods. Moreover, the adapter-based design slashes the number of trainable parameters and cuts computational overhead, enabling practical deployment in resource-constrained clinical settings.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了CAT-CKD,这是一个全新的MSFDA皮肤癌诊断框架,通过在适应过程中消除对源域图像的需求来维护患者的隐私. 首先,CAT通过SCL和轻量级适配器将域-不变量,类-差别化的表示法注入到ViT主干线中去,以减少过度适应,同时保留预先训练的知识. 接下来,CKD通过KL-divergence目标,将被冻结的源代码模型中的综艺知识转移到一个无标签目标数据的学生网络上. 5个公共皮肤数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的框架一贯优于传统的UDA和最先进的多来源无源方法。 此外,以适配器为基础的设计将可训练参数的数量剥去,并削减计算间接费用,从而能够在资源紧张的临床环境中实际部署。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on developing a more efficient source-domain training phase to reduce complexity. We will also investigate the robustness of the framework under different attack settings and privacy constraints. In addition, extending the approach to federated multi-source domain adaptation will be explored to further enhance its applicability in distributed and privacy-sensitive environments.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于发展更有效的源域培训阶段,以降低复杂性。 我们还将调查在不同攻击环境和隐私限制下,该框架是否健全。 此外,将探讨将多源联合域适应办法扩大,以进一步加强其在分布式和对隐私敏感的环境中的适用性。
